newsitem.title: USA: Westbridge offers $65 mln convertible notes.
newsitem.headline: Westbridge offers $65 mln convertible notes.

text.p: Westbridge Capital Corp said Thursday that it will offer $65 million of its 7.5 percent convertible subordinated notes due 2004 in a public offering. The offering is expected to close on April 29, subject to customary closing conditions.

Westbridge said it intends to use a portion of the proceeds to supplement the statutory capital and surplus of its insurance subsidiaries, which will permit it to increase the marketing of its underwritten health insurance products.
The rest of the money, said the company, will be used to recapture a block of reinsured insurance policies and for general corporate purposes.

Each $1,000 principal amount of the notes, said the company, is convertible into 91.575 shares of Westbridge common stock at an initial price of $10.92 per share. Interest is payable semi-annually, starting November 1.
Westbridge underwrites and markets individual medical expense and supplemental health insurance. It also markets HMO/PPO plans of nationally recognized, non-affiliated managed care companies.
